acceptanceScope: The production build and assets served by the complete Chromium run remained unchanged. Temporary CSS investigations on the separate development server were reverted. The complete run used its initially collected tests. A separate six-case final presentation run verified the later screenshot-only helper, which awaits paused rendering and retains CSS-pixel captures; scenario assertions were unchanged.

exploratoryRuns.name: initial model checks
exploratoryRuns.reason: Unpacked models exceeded the declared 7.5 MiB ceiling; an earlier milestone test also compared revised shared actors against its historical 192 KiB allowance.

exploratoryRuns.name: packed model checks
exploratoryRuns.reason: Packing met the catalog budget. Historical RFC-009 byte verification was separated from the explicit RFC-010 regional allowance; current bytes remain checked against the captured RFC-010 baseline.

exploratoryRuns.name: initial visual baseline selection
exploratoryRuns.reason: The missing-geometry negative control was too tolerant for the revised matte surfaces. Pixel threshold tightened from 0.20 to 0.12; maximum differing pixel ratio remained 0.02.

exploratoryRuns.name: first complete-suite attempt
exploratoryRuns.reason: Intentionally stopped for visible conversation-button contrast and Chapter I boat/cargo support corrections; not a completed acceptance run.

captureReview: Apparent text truncation in previews prompted software rendering, compositing and font checks. Original capture OCR with language correction disabled and matching DOM character bounds confirmed complete labels across all ten landscape scenes. Experimental CSS was reverted; no unsupported workaround ships.

review.manualLiveChecks: In-app Chromium: return conversation, pause, keyboard focus, portrait/landscape resizing and camera restoration. Independent native Blender imports and production browser matrices visually reviewed.

selectedEvidence.purpose: Architecture and principal people from independent final-export imports in Blender.
Distinct faces, garments and silhouettes from the shipped actors.
Final High Capernaum shore at the RFC-009 comparison position.
Both loaded boats, working net and panel-aware Chapter I composition.
Inhabited bakehouse, refined people, wall courses and floor textiles.
Large reading size, reduced motion and a recognized nearby speaker at phone width.

limits: Human discovery, comfort and narrative pacing review remains outstanding.
Physical touch and screen-reader review remains outstanding.
Sustained physical mobile GPU performance remains outstanding.
Firefox/WebKit coverage is a startup, keyboard, practical-action and saved-state smoke rather than the complete Chromium suite.
Vite retains its large-chunk advisory. No remote deployment or GitHub Actions execution is claimed.
